面向 18-30 岁年轻人的打工度假签证，允许在澳合法工作 12 个月，可续签至: Working Holiday visa for people aged 18–30, allowing up to 12 months of legal work in Australia and extensions up to a maximum of 3 years. Mainland Chinese passport holders use subclass 462 and must first be selected in a ballot pre-application before they can lodge. Annual quota: 5,000.
递交申请时必须年满 18 岁且未满 31 岁（即 30 周岁含）。抽签注册时亦须: You must be at least 18 and under 31 (that is, 30 inclusive) when you lodge. You must also fall inside this range when you register for the ballot.
满足以下任一条件即可：①持有大学、学院或培训中心颁发的高等教育学历（学位、研究生: Either condition qualifies: (1) hold a higher education qualification (degree, graduate certificate, diploma and so on) from a university, college or training provider; (2) have completed at least 2 years of undergraduate study. Current students may apply with proof of enrolment. Qualifications must be verifiable through CHSI.
以上任一项达标即可。成绩须在递交前 12 个月内考取。雅思 A 类或 G 类均可: Meeting any one of these is enough. Test results must be obtained within 12 months before lodging. Either IELTS Academic or General Training is accepted.
官方表述为'足够支持初期生活及离境的资金'，5,000 澳元为通行参考值。: The official wording is 'sufficient funds to support your initial stay and departure'; AUD 5,000 is the widely used reference figure.
约 5,000 澳元存款证明，用于证明初期生活能力。另需证明有足够资金购买返程机: Proof of about AUD 5,000 in savings to show you can support yourself initially. You must also show enough money for a return ticket.
官方预计约 3 个月（2026 年起为管理 WHM 项目高需求而延长处理时长）: About 3 months officially (processing was extended from 2026 to manage high demand for the WHM programme)
中国大陆年度名额 5,000 个（对比：印度 1,000、越南 1,500）。需: The mainland China quota is 5,000 a year (for comparison: India 1,000, Vietnam 1,500). You must register for the ballot pool and be randomly selected before you can lodge. Selection is not a grant.
2026-27 财年注册窗口。注册开放期仅 3 周，抽签选择期长达 10 个月。: Registration window for the 2026–27 programme year. Registration stays open for only 3 weeks while ballot selection runs up to 10 months. After selection you have 28 days to lodge.
2027-28 财年注册窗口的具体开放日期截至核实日尚未公布（2026-27 随: The exact opening date of the 2027–28 registration window had not been published as of the verification date (the 2026–27 ballot runs until 2027-04-30). Based on the 2026–27 arrangement, which opened in early June for about 3 weeks, register an ImmiAccount and prepare documents before May 2027, and treat Department of Home Affairs announcements as authoritative.
有效期须超过 6 个月，首页彩色扫描件: Must be valid for more than 6 months; colour scan of the bio page
高等教育学历证明 / 在读证明: Higher education qualification / proof of enrolment
需学信网中英文认证: Requires CHSI verification in Chinese and English
雅思/PTE/托福/Cambridge，12 个月内有效: IELTS / PTE / TOEFL / Cambridge, valid within 12 months
约 5,000 澳元等值，建议多准备 30%: Equivalent of about AUD 5,000; preparing 30% extra is advisable
移民局指定医院出具: Issued by a panel physician designated by the department
由 CICETE 出具，办理周期 2 周至 3 个月: Issued by CICETE; takes 2 weeks to 3 months
符合澳洲签证规格的电子照片: Digital photo meeting Australian visa specifications
返程机票资金证明: Proof of funds for a return ticket
提前 1-2 个月准备学历认证、语言成绩、存款证明、无犯罪记录、政府支持信等。材: Start 1–2 months ahead on qualification verification, the English test, bank proof, the police check and the government support letter. Without a complete set you cannot finish registering inside the open window.

在澳洲内政部官网创建 ImmiAccount，选择 New applicatio: Create an ImmiAccount on the Department of Home Affairs website, choose New application → Visa pre-application registration → Registration - Work and Holiday Visa (462), enter your details (name, date of birth, passport number, ID number) and verify your email.
支付注册费并提交: Pay the registration fee and submit
支付 AUD 25 抽签注册费。提交后状态从 draft 变为 received: Pay the AUD 25 ballot registration fee. On submission the status moves from draft to received, which places you in the ballot pool. Note: a submitted registration cannot be edited.
等待随机抽签结果: Wait for the random ballot result
抽签期长达 10 个月，随时可能中签。中签后状态变为 selected 并收到邮: The ballot runs up to 10 months and selection can happen at any time. If selected, the status becomes selected and you get an email. Unsuccessful registrations receive no notice and stay at received until the ballot ends. Selection is purely random and cannot be influenced.
中签后递交正式签证申请: Lodge the full visa application after selection
收到中签通知后 28 天内，在 ImmiAccount 中递交正式签证申请并支付: Within 28 days of the selection notice, lodge the full application in ImmiAccount and pay the AUD 840 visa charge. Late applications lapse.
预约移民局指定医院完成体检（含胸腔 X 光）。体检结果由医院直接提交移民局。: Book a panel physician for the medical examination, including a chest X-ray. The clinic submits the results directly to the department.
等待签证获批。获批后须在 1 年内入境澳大利亚，入境后才开始计算 12 个月停留: Wait for the visa grant. After grant you must enter Australia within 1 year, and the 12-month stay starts counting from entry.
抽签完全随机，年度名额仅 5,000 个，中签率低。中签不等于获批，仍须满足全部: Selection is entirely random with only 5,000 places a year, so the odds are low. Selection is not a grant and every eligibility condition still applies.
注册信息一经提交无法修改，填写时务必核对护照号等关键信息。: A submitted registration cannot be edited, so check the passport number and other key details carefully before submitting.
2026 年 7 月 1 日起签证费从 AUD 670 涨至 AUD 840（涨: From 1 July 2026 the visa charge rose from AUD 670 to AUD 840, a 25% increase. Fees may be adjusted again.
新法规将年龄标准从 Schedule 2 移至 Schedule 1：若递交时超: New regulations moved the age criterion from Schedule 2 to Schedule 1: if you are over the age limit when lodging, the application is invalid and the visa charge is not refunded.
出发前总预算建议准备人民币 1.2-1.7 万元（含签证费、机票、保险、落地首月: Budget roughly CNY 12,000–17,000 before departure, covering the visa charge, flights, insurance and your first month on the ground. Australia's minimum hourly wage is about AUD 23–24.
可从事全职、兼职、临时及轮班工作。可为同一雇主工作不超过 6 个月。可学习不超过: Full-time, part-time, casual and shift work are all allowed. You may work for the same employer for no more than 6 months and study for no more than 4 months.
在首个 462 签证期间，于指定区域完成 3 个月特定工作（通常为农业、旅游业等: Complete 3 months of specified work, usually agriculture or tourism, in a designated area during your first 462 visa to apply for a second year; complete 6 months of specified work during the second to apply for a third.
加拿大与 30 多个国家和地区签订的青年流动协议，允许 18-35 岁青年在加工: A youth mobility arrangement between Canada and more than 30 countries and territories, letting people aged 18–35 work in Canada for up to 12 months per stay (Hong Kong and Taiwan are both 12 months; some partners allow 24). ⚠️ Mainland China is not on the list, so mainland Chinese passport holders cannot apply. Much of the 'Canada working holiday' content online is really about employer-sponsored work permits, which are entirely different from IEC.
18-35 周岁（官方总述 \"If you're 18 to 35 (18 t: 18–35 (official wording "If you're 18 to 35 (18 to 30 in some countries)"). Per the by-country table, Hong Kong SAR is 18 to 30 and Taiwan 18 to 35; most other partners are 18–35.
无学历硬性要求（依各签约地区协议而定）: No formal education requirement (depends on each partner arrangement)
官方三个主源页面（iec.html、eligibility.html、eligi: None of the three official source pages (iec.html, eligibility.html, eligibility-by-country.html) lists a language test requirement (0 hits for IELTS / language test). The earlier IELTS 24-month record had no official basis and was removed; whether a language requirement exists elsewhere could not be verified.
具体金额依签约地区协议而定: The exact amount depends on the partner arrangement
约 6 周（官方：Current processing time 6 weeks: About 6 weeks (official: Current processing time 6 weeks after you submit all documents and give biometrics)
中国大陆不在协议内，无配额。官方主源未公布中国香港、中国台湾的年度配额数字（未能: Mainland China is not a partner, so there is no quota. The official sources do not publish annual quotas for Hong Kong or Taiwan (unverified).
官方原文：2026 IEC season is closed / The poo: Official wording: 2026 IEC season is closed / The pools for the 2026 season are closed. Anyone holding an ITA can still submit a work permit application; profiles without an ITA were removed from the pool, and the official guidance is that a new profile can be created when the 2027 season opens. Mainland China cannot apply, so no window applies.
官方原文 Processing fees CAN $184.75；官方注「Add: Official wording: Processing fees CAN $184.75, with the official note "Additional fees may apply." Biometrics and other charges are separate and not included.
须为签约国家/地区签发的护照: Must be a passport issued by a partner country or territory
确认护照资格（第一步，也可能是终点）: Confirm passport eligibility (step one, and possibly the last)
加拿大 IEC 仅对签约国家/地区护照开放。中国大陆护照不在名单内。若持中国大陆: Canada's IEC opens only to passports from partner countries and territories. Mainland Chinese passports are not on the list, so this programme is unavailable to them and no further steps apply.

（仅限合格护照持有人）在 IRCC 官网创建账号，提交候选人档案进入抽签池。: (Eligible passport holders only) create an account on the IRCC website and submit a candidate profile to enter the pool.

（仅限合格护照持有人）被抽中后收到申请邀请（Invitation to Appl: (Eligible passport holders only) once selected you receive an Invitation to Apply and must submit a complete application within the deadline.
⚠️ 中国大陆护照不可申请。这是一个显式排除记录，用于纠正中文互联网上广泛流传的: ⚠️ Mainland Chinese passports cannot apply. This is an explicit exclusion record, kept to correct misinformation that circulates widely in Chinese-language media.
大量中介把'加拿大雇主担保工签'包装成'加拿大打工度假'进行推广。两者性质完全不: Many agencies market an 'employer-sponsored Canadian work permit' as a 'Canada working holiday'. The two are entirely different: IEC is an open work permit with no employer involved, while an employer-sponsored permit needs an employer and has far higher thresholds.
本记录的存在价值：帮助中国大陆学生快速排除一个不可行的选项，避免浪费时间和金钱。: The value of this record is helping mainland Chinese students rule out an unavailable option quickly, instead of wasting time and money.
无犯罪记录证明、体检、语言考试三项已从资格条件中移除：官方三个主源页面检索 cr: The police check, medical examination and language test were removed from the eligibility criteria: searches for criminal / police / medical exam / IELTS on the three official pages return 0 hits, and the only comparable wording is the admissibility condition "not be inadmissible to Canada". The removal rests on negative evidence, which does not prove they are never requested; individual cases may still require them (unverified).
开放式工签，可为任意雇主工作，无需雇主担保。停留期 12 个月为中国香港、中国台: An open work permit, so you can work for any employer without sponsorship. The 12-month stay is the official ceiling for the Hong Kong and Taiwan passports (up to 12 months); other partners can reach 24 months. The three official pages mention no study limit (study appears only in the TEER education context), so the earlier max_study_months=6 was removed for lack of basis (unverified).
不可续签。中国香港护照持有人「may participate in IEC on: Not renewable. Hong Kong passport holders "may participate in IEC only once" and Taiwan passport holders "only once"; both eligible passport types can take part just once.
面向非欧盟高校在读生（或毕业不超过 2 年）的实习居留许可，允许在德国企业进行最: A residence permit for internships aimed at students enrolled at non-EU universities, or graduates within the last 2 years, allowing an internship of up to 6 months with a German company in the field studied. Mainland Chinese students can apply. A German internship contract is needed first.
德国联邦政府 / 各地外国人管理局（Ausländerbehörde）: German federal government / local foreigners authorities (Ausländerbehörde)
无年龄上限。未满 18 岁需监护人同意其停留计划。: No upper age limit. Applicants under 18 need a guardian's consent for the stay.
须满足任一条件：①目前仍在非欧盟国家高校就读；②在申请前 2 年内已取得非欧盟国: Either condition: (1) currently enrolled at a university outside the EU; (2) obtained a non-EU university qualification within the 2 years before applying. **The internship must match your field and level of study.** Qualification comparability follows the assessment guidance of the German Central Office for Foreign Education (ZAB, anabin database).
官方无强制语言考试要求，但实习单位通常要求英语或德语工作能力。: No mandatory language test officially, but host companies usually expect working proficiency in English or German.
资金须覆盖整个实习期。: Funds must cover the whole internship.
**每月**至少 752 欧元。可通过以下任一方式证明：①德国银行阻塞账户（Sp: At least EUR 752 **per month**. Prove it with any of: (1) a German blocked account (Sperrkonto) with a monthly withdrawal limit of EUR 752; (2) a scholarship award letter; (3) a declaration of commitment (Verpflichtungserklärung) signed by the local German foreigners authority.
无名额限制。但须先获得德国雇主实习合同。: No quota, but a German internship contract is required first.
全年可申请，无固定开放窗口。关键前置条件：先拿到德国雇主实习合同。建议在计划出行: Applications run all year with no fixed window. The key precondition is a German internship contract. Start preparing 3–4 months before your intended departure.
特定条件下可减免: Reduced or waived under certain conditions
完整并签署的签证申请表: Completed and signed visa application form
有效期至少 6 个月，10 年内签发，至少 2 页空白页；需复印照片页及签证页: Valid for at least 6 months, issued within the last 10 years, with at least 2 blank pages; photocopy the bio page and the visa pages
简历 + 学位证书/在读证明: CV + degree certificate / proof of enrolment
阻塞账户每月 ≥ 752 欧元，或奖学金/担保声明: Blocked account of at least EUR 752 per month, or a scholarship / declaration of commitment
覆盖全程，保额 ≥ 30,000 欧元: Covering the whole stay with at least EUR 30,000 of cover
联邦就业局预批: Pre-approval from the Federal Employment Agency

Day 28 must be within 31 days of applying for this visa.` — 28 consecutive days held, with day 28 falling within 31 days before filing. This time window trips people up more often than the amount.
官方按来源地分两档：澳大利亚、加拿大、新西兰、韩国为 18-35 岁；其余签约地: The official page splits sources into two age bands: Australia, Canada, New Zealand and South Korea at 18-35; every other participating place (including Hong Kong, Taiwan, Japan, Andorra, Iceland, Monaco, San Marino and Uruguay) at 18-30. The test is not 'inside the band on filing day' but the original wording `You must be aged 18 or over when your visa starts, or 35 or under when you apply for it.` (30 for the other band) — at least 18 when the visa takes effect, no older than the cap when you apply; you may file before turning 18 and still be over the cap when it starts. The max here is the overall 35; Hong Kong and Taiwan are actually 30.
常规居留许可签发不要求无犯罪记录证明；涉及特定职业（如教师、护理）时雇主侧另有要: An ordinary residence permit does not require a criminal record certificate; specific professions (teaching, nursing) may impose their own check on the employer side.
常规约 3 周出结果。获批后按签证生效日入境，24 个月从生效日起算。: Usually a decision in about 3 weeks. Once granted, enter on the visa start date; the 24 months run from that date.
年龄分档原文：`You can apply for the visa if yo: Age bands in the original: `You can apply for the visa if you're aged 18 to 35 and from: Australia, Canada, New Zealand, South Korea`; `You can apply for the visa if you're aged 18 to 30 and from: Andorra, Iceland, Japan, Monaco, San Marino, Uruguay`. The test: `You must be aged 18 or over when your visa starts, or 35 or under when you apply for it.` Ballot: `You must be selected in the Youth Mobility Scheme ballot before you can apply for your visa if you're from: Hong Kong, if you have an SAR passport; Taiwan`. Bars: `children under the age of 18 who live with you`, `children you're financially responsible for`, `already been in the UK under the scheme`. Funds: `You must have at least £2,530 in your bank account`, `You will need to have had the money available for at least 28 days in a row. Day 28 must be within 31 days of applying for this visa.` **China does not appear anywhere on the page.**
延期原文：`Certain F-1 students who receive s: Extension text: `Certain F-1 students who receive science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) degrees may apply for a 24-month extension of their post-completion optional practical training (OPT).` Three eligibility conditions: `Have been granted OPT and currently be in a valid period of post-completion OPT`; `Have earned a bachelor's, master's, or doctoral degree from a school that is accredited by a U.S. Department of Education-recognized accrediting agency and is certified by the Student and Exchange Visitor Program (SEVP)`; and an E-Verify employer. Employer duties: `Be enrolled in E-Verify`, `Remain a participant in good standing with E-Verify`, `Have a valid Employer Identification Number (EIN)`, `Report material changes ... by submitting a modified Form I-983 to the DSO`, `Report the STEM OPT student's termination of employment or departure to the DSO within 5 business days.`, `Provide an OPT opportunity that is commensurate with those of similarly situated U.S. workers in duties, hours, and compensation.` Site visits: `DHS may, at its discretion, conduct a site visit of the employer`. Training plan: `The employer must attest to this fact by signing the Form I-983, Training Plan for STEM OPT Students.` Unemployment table: `Initial post-completion OPT only — Up to 90 days — 90 days`; `24-month extension — An additional 60 days — 150 days`.
德国外管局普遍需要提前预约（Termin），热门城市排期可达数月。等居留快到期才: German foreigners authorities generally require a booked appointment (Termin), and waits in popular cities run to months. Booking only when your permit is nearly up often means no slot and a forced departure.
德国居留申请必备，证明已在当地登记落户: Required for any German residence application; proves you have registered at a local address
德国毕业后求职居留许可（§20 AufenthG）: Job-search residence permit after graduation in Germany (§20 AufenthG)
德国联邦司法与消费者保护部（法条发布）/ 各地外国人管理局（Ausländerb: German Federal Ministry of Justice and Consumer Protection (publishes the statute) / local foreigners authorities (Ausländerbehörde, which actually issue the permit)
必须在前置学生居留仍有效时、在德国境内申请。毕业后回国再想回来走这条路不成立——: You must apply from inside Germany while the prior student residence permit is still valid. Going home after graduation and coming back this way does not work — from abroad only the §20a Opportunity Card is available, with a different set of conditions (six-point threshold, cap, 20 hours a week).
找到与学历匹配的岗位后，转为 §18b 欧盟蓝卡或 §18a 技术移民居留。§2: Once you find a role matching your qualification, switch to an EU Blue Card (§18b) or a skilled-worker permit (§18a). The 18 months under §20 cannot be extended; if you have not switched by then you must leave.
抽签中签邮件（仅中国香港、中国台湾）: Ballot-success email (Hong Kong and Taiwan only)
拿到 EAD（I-766）后才能开始工作，卡上起始日之前的任何工作都算非法就业。: You may only start work once the EAD (Form I-766) is in hand; any work before the start date printed on the card is unlawful employment. You may not begin before approval.
按德国居留法收费条例的常规上限口径估算。各地外管局实际收费与减免政策不一，具体金: A rough estimate against the usual upper bound in the German residence fee schedule. Actual charges and waivers differ between authorities; the exact amount is unverified.
按预约时间到场，提交材料、采集生物信息、缴费。居留卡随后邮寄，期间会给一张临时证: Attend at the appointed time, submit documents, give biometrics and pay. The card arrives by post; meanwhile you are issued a temporary certificate (Fiktionsbescheinigung).
提交申请后 DSO 在 SEVIS 里录入推荐并签发带推荐的 I-20。推荐日期: After you file, the DSO enters the recommendation in SEVIS and issues an I-20 bearing it. Once that recommendation date is set, Form I-765 must be filed within 30 days; anything later is denied outright.
提前 28 天把 £2,530 存进账户并保持不动: Deposit £2,530 and leave it untouched for 28 days beforehand
无名额上限，按个人毕业时间滚动申请。真正的约束是三个日期：毕业前 90 天起可递: No annual cap; applications roll with your own graduation date. The real constraints are three dates: from 90 days before graduation, no later than 60 days after, and within 30 days of the DSO recommendation.
无犯罪记录证明（仅安道尔、冰岛、圣马力诺）: Criminal record certificate (Andorra, Iceland, San Marino only)
时长原文：`Eligible students can apply to rec: Duration text: `Eligible students can apply to receive up to 12 months of OPT employment authorization before completing their academic studies (pre-completion) and/or after completing their academic studies (post-completion). However, all periods of pre-completion OPT will be deducted from the available period of post-completion OPT.` Deduction rule: `If you spend one year in part-time pre-completion OPT, you will be deducted 6 months from your post-completion OPT. If you spend one year in full-time pre-completion OPT, you will be deducted 12 months ... and you will not have any remaining OPT.` Hours: pre-completion `you may work (20 hours or less per week) while school is in session. You may work full time when school is not in session.`; post-completion `you must work part time (at least 20 hours per week) or full time.` Filing windows: `May apply up to 90 days before you complete your degree, but no later than 60 days after you complete your degree.` and `Must apply within 30 days after your DSO enters the recommendation`. Process: `Request that your designated school official (DSO) ... recommend the OPT`, `Properly file Form I-765, Application for Employment Authorization with USCIS`.
明文不可延长：`Die Verlängerung nach Absatz 1 ü: Expressly non-extendable: `Die Verlängerung nach Absatz 1 über diese Zeiträume hinaus ist ausgeschlossen.` Routes 1-4 of subsection (1) run up to 18 months; route 5 (care assistant training) runs up to 12 months and may be extended once by up to 6 months. At expiry you must switch to a work permit (§18a / §18b) or leave.
有效期须覆盖申请的居留期；护照剩余有效期不足时外管局可能只批到护照到期日: Must cover the residence period applied for; if the passport expires sooner the authority may only grant a permit up to that date
有未成年子女同住、或对子女负有抚养义务的人不可申请。这不是「不带孩子就行」，而是: Anyone with dependent children under 18 living with them, or financially responsible for children, cannot apply. This is about status, not about leaving the children behind.
未在 E-Verify 注册的雇主（仅 STEM 延期阶段受此限）: Employers not enrolled in E-Verify (STEM extension stage only)
本签证能读的课程被限定为「不符合学生签证条件」的那一类。想借毕业生签证再读一个学: This visa only allows study on courses that are not themselves eligible for a Student visa. To take another degree with a Graduate visa, if the course qualifies for a Student visa you must extend your Student visa instead; studying it on a Graduate visa is a breach.
材料原文：`a valid passport or other document: Document text: `a valid passport or other document that shows your identity and nationality`, `a bank statement showing you have at least £2,530 in savings`, `your tuberculosis (TB) test results if you're from a country where you have to take the test`, `a certified translation of any documents that are not in English or Welsh`. Additional by source: Andorra `Andorran certificate of criminal records`, Iceland `Icelandic criminal certificate for private use (called a Sakavottorð)`, a San Marino foreign ministry letter, Uruguay `Uruguayan certificate of judicial records` — all issued within 6 months of applying; Hong Kong and Taiwan must provide `a valid email from the Home Office confirming you were successful in the Youth Mobility Scheme ballot`.
来自英国列为需筛查的国家且拟停留 6 个月以上者须提供；中国大陆在筛查名单内。证: Required for applicants from countries on the UK screening list staying 6 months or more; mainland China is on that list. The certificate is valid for 6 months from the date of the x-ray
每个学历层级各 12 个月，用完不补。此前读过 pre-completion O: Each educational level grants 12 months and nothing carries over. If you used pre-completion OPT, a year full-time deducted the full 12 months and a year part-time deducted 6, so work out what remains first.
求职期间可以从事任何工作（包括与学历无关的），这一点与机会卡不同：§20a 明确: Any job is allowed while you search, including work unrelated to your degree — unlike the Opportunity Card, which limits work to skilled employment at no more than 20 hours a week. The 18 months run from the card issue date and do not pause when you find a job.
法定医保或同等商业医保。学生医保在毕业后通常失效，需要转为自愿投保或求职者保险: Statutory or equivalent private cover. Student insurance normally ends at graduation, so you need voluntary or jobseeker cover
法条未设年龄限制。0-99 表示「官方无年龄要求」，不是「未核实」。: The statute sets no age limit. 0-99 means 'no official age requirement', not 'unverified'.
法规未设年龄限制。0-99 表示「官方无年龄要求」，不是「未核实」。: The regulation sets no age limit. 0-99 means 'no official age requirement', not 'unverified'.
法规未设资金门槛，但 OPT 期间的失业天数有硬上限（见 work_condit: The regulation sets no funds threshold, but unemployment days during OPT are hard-capped (see work_conditions), which in practice forces you to find work quickly. The I-765 fee is on top.
现场递交并录指纹: Submit in person and give biometrics
生计保障是硬条件，不是软性说明。存款不足又拿不出担保函或劳动合同，外管局可以据此: Subsistence is a hard condition, not a soft note. Insufficient savings with no guarantee letter or contract is grounds for refusal. Local interpretations of the amount differ, so the same file can produce different outcomes in different cities.
由 DSO 在 SEVIS 录入推荐后签发并签字。上面的推荐日期决定 30 天与: Issued and signed by the DSO after the recommendation is entered in SEVIS. The recommendation date on it sets both the 30-day and the 60-day windows
申请时该居留必须仍有效；这是 §20 第 1 款第 1 条成立的前提: The permit must still be valid when you apply; that is the precondition for §20(1) no. 1
确认学历层级与剩余额度: Confirm your educational level and remaining entitlement
确认护照来源地在名单内（第一步，也可能是终点）: Confirm your source is on the list (step one, possibly the end of the road)
确认自己落在 §20 第 1 款的哪一条: Work out which route of §20(1) you fall under
等待 EAD 并核对起止日期: Wait for the EAD and check its start and end dates
签证费 £340；IHS 每年 £776（2 年 £1,552）；生物识别 £1: Visa fee £340; IHS £776 a year (£1,552 for two years); biometrics £19. Roughly £1,911 in total.
约 2,530 英镑，用于覆盖抵英初期生活费。须连续持有 28 天，第 28 天: About £2,530, meant to cover initial living costs in the UK. Must be held for 28 consecutive days, with day 28 falling within 31 days before filing
美国 F-1 毕业后实习工作许可（OPT）: Optional Practical Training (OPT) for F-1 graduates in the US
自雇或自主创业（无合资格的雇主—雇员关系，通常不被认可）: Self-employment or starting a business (no qualifying employer-employee relationship, so generally not accepted)
至少 £2,530，连续持有 28 天，第 28 天须在递交前 31 天内: At least £2,530, held for 28 consecutive days, with day 28 within 31 days before filing
若持本签证去读或研究敏感课题（部分工程、材料、物理方向），需提前申请 Acade: If you use this visa to study or research sensitive topics (some engineering, materials or physics areas) you need an ATAS certificate in advance. Not needed for plain job hunting or work
若换过学校或升过学历层级，须一并提交，用于核算法定 12 个月额度: If you changed schools or moved up a level, submit them all; they are used to work out the statutory 12 months
英国 YMS 只对签约国家/地区开放。18-35 岁档：澳大利亚、加拿大、新西兰: The UK YMS is open only to participating countries and territories. The 18-35 band covers Australia, Canada, New Zealand and South Korea. The 18-30 band covers Andorra, Iceland, Japan, Monaco, San Marino and Uruguay, plus Hong Kong (SAR passport) and Taiwan which must win a ballot first, and three British overseas categories. Mainland China appears in neither band.
英文对照确认同一口径：`In the cases covered by subs: The English version confirms the same reading: `In the cases covered by subsection (1) nos. 1 to 4, the temporary residence permit is granted for a period of up to 18 months. In the cases covered by subsection (1) no. 5, it is granted for a period of up to 12 months and may be extended once by up to six months if the foreigner's subsistence is secured. It may not be extended beyond these maximum periods.` and `The temporary residence permit is granted pursuant to subsection (1) on the condition that the foreigner's subsistence is secured.` The same page carries the English of §20a, useful for telling the two routes apart: §20a allows `to pursue employment of up to 20 hours per week`.
英文或威尔士文翻译件: Certified translation into English or Welsh
资金证明的时间窗比金额更容易出错：£2,530 须连续持有 28 天，且第 28: The timing of the funds evidence is easier to get wrong than the amount: £2,530 held for 28 consecutive days, with day 28 within 31 days before filing. A salary credit, a withdrawal, or moving the money between accounts can all restart the clock.
资金证明要求连续 28 天持有，且第 28 天须在递交前 31 天内。临时借入、: The funds rule requires 28 consecutive days of holding, with day 28 falling within 31 days before filing. Borrowing temporarily, withdrawing midway, or moving money between accounts can void the 28 days and restart the count.
这两个来源地不能直接递交，须先被 Youth Mobility Scheme b: These two sources cannot file directly; they must first be selected in the Youth Mobility Scheme ballot. The original reads `You must be selected in the Youth Mobility Scheme ballot before you can apply for your visa`. Only with the Home Office email can you enter the formal application. Ballot windows open a few times a year; missing one means waiting for the next.
递交 I-765 时须在美国境内且持有效 F-1 身份。境外无法递交。: Form I-765 must be filed from inside the US while holding valid F-1 status. It cannot be filed from abroad.
通常不需要体检。但须持有德国法定或同等医疗保险，这是签发居留的通行前提。: A medical examination is usually not required. You must however hold German statutory or equivalent private health insurance, a general precondition for issuing a residence permit.
非法条明文要求，但部分外管局会问求职方向。提前准备一份能说明目标岗位的材料可减少: Not required in the statute, but some authorities ask about your job-search direction. A short note explaining target roles reduces questioning
非英文/威尔士文的材料须提供 certified translation: Documents not in English or Welsh need a certified translation
须为申请前 6 个月内签发；圣马力诺为外交部出具的 suitability 函: Must be issued within 6 months before applying; for San Marino it is a suitability letter from the foreign ministry
须为签约国家/地区签发的护照；香港须为 SAR 护照: Must be a passport issued by a participating country or territory; Hong Kong must be an SAR passport
须在当前 post-completion OPT 有效期内、到期前 90 天起递: Must be filed while current post-completion OPT is still valid, from 90 days before it expires; the employer must be enrolled in and in good standing with E-Verify and must sign Form I-983. The extension raises the unemployment cap from 90 to 150 days.
须在德国境内、且前置居留（学生居留等）仍然有效时向外管局申请。毕业即离境再回来申: You must apply to the foreigners authority from inside Germany while the prior residence permit (student residence and so on) is still valid. Leaving right after graduation and applying from abroad does not work.
须已完成全部学业要求。部分外管局接受学校的完成确认函，不必等正式证书: All academic requirements must be complete. Some authorities accept a school confirmation letter, so you need not wait for the formal certificate
须已完成学位课程的全部课程要求（论文除外）。本科、硕士、博士均可，每个学历层级各: All course requirements for the degree must be complete (thesis excepted). Bachelor's, master's and doctoral degrees all qualify; each educational level grants 12 months, and moving up a level grants another 12. The work must relate directly to your major, endorsed by the DSO on the I-20 and reviewed by USCIS.
须由 DSO 在 SEVIS 中录入 OPT 推荐并签发带推荐的 I-20。I-: The DSO must enter the OPT recommendation in SEVIS and issue an I-20 bearing it. The recommendation date on the I-20 starts the clock; filing must happen within 30 days.
须缴移民健康附加费（IHS），YMS 档为每年 £776，2 年签证 £1,55: Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) is mandatory; the YMS rate is £776 a year, £1,552 for a two-year visa, covering NHS access.
须覆盖整段 OPT 期间；护照到期会影响后续 H-1B 或出境再入境: Must cover the whole OPT period; an expiring passport complicates a later H-1B or re-entry
领取公共福利（public funds）与国家养老金: Claiming public funds and the State Pension
须由学校 DSO 在 SEVIS 中录入 OPT 推荐并签发带推荐的 I-20。: Your school's DSO must enter the OPT recommendation in SEVIS and issue an I-20 bearing it. This is an official supporting document from the school, not proof of enrolment — post-completion OPT is applied for precisely after all degree requirements are done. The recommendation date on the I-20 starts the clock; filing must be completed within 30 days.
德国毕业后求职居留许可: Job-search residence permit after graduation in Germany
依据 AufenthG §20，在德国读完学位、做完研究、完成职业培训或通过职业: Under §20 AufenthG, after finishing a degree, research post, vocational training or qualification recognition in Germany you can apply for a job-search residence permit of up to 18 months, during which you may look for work and take any job. It is not the Opportunity Card (§20a): §20 is for people who already completed their studies in Germany, while §20a is for third-country nationals still abroad who want to enter to look for work. A mainland China passport holder qualifies once their studies in Germany are complete.
在澳洲读完学位后的毕业后工签，本科与授课型硕士 2 年、研究型硕士与博士 3 年: A post-study work visa for graduates of Australian institutions: 2 years for bachelor and coursework master degrees, 3 years for research masters and doctoral degrees, and 5 years for Hong Kong and BNO passport holders. No employer sponsorship and no job offer required; you can work, study and bring family. The hard gate is age: you must be 35 or under when you apply, be in Australia, and have held a Student visa in the last 6 months. Mainland China passport holders face no nationality bar; the gate is qualification and age.
官方资格页未设国籍限制，门槛在年龄、学历与在澳学习经历。香港与英国国民（海外）B: The official eligibility page sets no nationality restriction; the gates are age, qualification and study in Australia. Hong Kong and British National Overseas (BNO) passport holders get a separate benefit: up to 5 years instead of 2-3 years, with a possible permanent residency pathway after 5 years. Mainland China passports follow the standard 2-3 year rule.
官方原文 `be aged 35 years or under when you: Official wording: be aged 35 years or under when you apply. *Exceptions apply. The test is your age on the application date, not at enrolment or graduation. The 35 cap replaced a 50 cap in 2024, so anyone relying on the old rule is now ineligible. Hong Kong and BNO holders get a stay-length benefit, but the age test still follows the official exception clauses.
须在递交前 6 个月内完成合格的 CRICOS 注册课程。学习要求为「2 个学年: You must have completed an eligible CRICOS-registered course within the 6 months before you apply. The study requirement is 2 academic years: either one course registered for at least 2 academic years, or several courses totalling at least 2 academic years that end in an eligible qualification, with at least 16 calendar months of study actually completed in Australia. Two academic years converts to 92 weeks based on CRICOS-registered duration, not the time you actually took, so studying slowly does not add weeks and credit transfer removes them. English language courses and enabling programmes do not count.
须随申请提供英语能力证明（官方原文 `provide evidence of t: You must provide evidence of English with your application (official wording: provide evidence of the required level of English with your application.). The 485 page names only the required level and does not list scores; check the scores against the level tables on the Home Affairs English requirements page. The approved test list changed on 7 August 2025; results from before that date remain valid for a limited period that depends on the visa subclass (up to 3 years).
官方未设存款证明门槛。但须缴签证费 5,750 澳元（主申请人），另需自付体检、: No savings threshold is set. You do pay a visa charge of AUD 5,750 for the main applicant, plus medical checks, police checks and health insurance out of pocket.
递交时人必须在澳洲境内（官方原文 `be in Australia when y: You must be in Australia when you apply (official wording: be in Australia when you apply for this visa), and not in immigration clearance (You can be in Australia (but not in immigration clearance) when you apply). You may be inside or outside Australia when the decision is made.
过去 6 个月内须持有过学生签证（官方原文 `have held a Stude: You must have held a Student visa in the last 6 months (have held a Student visa in the last 6 months) and hold an eligible visa (hold an eligible visa). The visa can only be held once as a primary applicant, and you cannot change streams after you apply (it is not possible to change streams after you apply).
须为所有申请人提供足够的健康保险证明（`provide evidence of: You must provide evidence of adequate health insurance for all applicants (provide evidence of adequate health insurance for all applicants when you apply) and meet the department's health requirement, which means medical checks.
递交时须提供已申请澳洲联邦警察（AFP）无犯罪记录的证明（`provide ev: You must show you have applied for an Australian Federal Police (AFP) check when you apply (provide evidence you have applied for an Australian Federal Police check when you apply) and meet the character requirement. Note this is proof of application, not a completed result.
无名额上限，按个人毕业时间滚动递交。主要时间约束是「递交前 6 个月内完成课程」: No annual cap. Applications roll with each person's graduation date. The real time limits are two rolling windows: completing the course within 6 months before applying, and having held a Student visa in the last 6 months.
全年滚动。页面标注 `Last updated: 5 November 2026: Rolling all year. The page carries Last updated: 5 November 2026. The 35-year age cap and the 7 August 2025 English test list change are both recent amendments.
同上，无年度窗口。政策按公告日切换而非自然年，递交前须重新核对。: As above, no annual window. Rules switch on announcement dates rather than calendar years, so re-check the current round before lodging.
官方原文 `The visa costs AUD5,750.00 for the: Official wording: The visa costs AUD5,750.00 for the main applicant (concessions apply in limited circumstances). Citizens of Pacific island countries and Timor-Leste pay a lower rate.
官方不公布固定时长，只提供 Visa processing time guide: No fixed processing time is published. PGWP 是开放式工签，可换雇主、可自雇。这段时间的加拿大工作经验是快速通道（E: The PGWP is an open work permit, so you can change employers and be self-employed. Canadian work experience during this period is a core scoring factor for the Canadian Experience Class under Express Entry.

系统文档清单不会提示「合格专业领域证明」，须自行上传到 Client infor: The system document checklist does not prompt for proof of an eligible field of study; you must upload it to the Client information section yourself. Omitting it is treated as an incomplete application.

Graduates of foreign institutions can also apply, but the institution must rank in the top 200 of at least two of THE, QS and ShanghaiRanking, and the degree must be evaluated by Nuffic. IND 页面按「你在哪读书、什么时候毕业」判断，不按国籍排除。中国大陆护照持有人: The IND page decides by where you studied and when you graduated, not by nationality. 满足以下任一情形即可：①在荷兰高等教育机构完成经认证的本科或硕士项目；②在荷兰完: Any one of the following is enough: (1) an accredited bachelor's or master's programme at a Dutch higher education institution; (2) a post-master's programme of at least one academic year (at least 10 months) in the Netherlands; (3) a study programme in the Netherlands under the Cultural Policy (Special-Purpose Funding) Act; (4) a study programme in the Netherlands under the development cooperation policy of the Dutch Ministry of Foreign Affairs; (5) a master's, doctoral or post-master's programme at a designated foreign institution; (6) scientific research in the Netherlands within 3 years before the application, under a research permit pursuant to Directive (EU) 2016/801 or a research-based highly skilled migrant permit whose contract carries a UFO job code starting with 01; (7) a master's degree from an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master programme obtained within 3 years before the application.

入境后须做结核病（TB）筛查，在拿到居留许可后 3 个月内到市政卫生服务局（GG: A tuberculosis (TB) screening is required after arrival: book it with the municipal health service (GGD) within 3 months of receiving the permit. 在荷兰境内可在线申请（需 DigiD、BSN、BRP 登记、且毕业后仍持有效居留: From inside the Netherlands you can apply online, which requires DigiD, a BSN, BRP registration and a still-valid permit for the study purpose. 这一年不计入永久居留所需的居住年限，也不是工作许可的替代品——它只是给你时间找工: The year does not count towards the residence years required for permanent residence and is not a substitute for a work permit; it only buys time to find work. If no work-related permit is obtained by the end of the year, you have to leave.

奥地利的高资质人才通道：按 100 分制打分，满 70 分即可。没有工作邀请也能: Austria's route for very highly qualified workers: a 100-point scale, 70 points to qualify. You can enter first on a six-month job-seeker visa with no job offer, then switch to a 24-month Red-White-Red Card once you find a matching position; after 21 months of qualifying employment you can move to the unrestricted Red-White-Red Card plus. 德语或英语达到 CEFR A1 得 5 分，A2 得 10 分（本项上限 10: German or English at CEFR A1 scores 5, A2 scores 10 (this item caps at 10). French, Spanish or Bosnian/Croatian/Serbian at B1 score 5 each. 申请找工作签证时须提供「足够生计来源」证明（工资单、雇佣合同、养老金凭证、投资或: A job-seeker visa application needs proof of adequate means of subsistence (payslips, employment contract, pension or insurance benefits, investment capital or sufficient own assets); no fixed amount is published. A university degree usually gives three years at a time, a vocational qualification (three or more years at upper-secondary level) gives one year at a time, and the special-qualifications route requires at least six years of work experience. The job must be full time or at least an 80% position, and pay and conditions must not be poorer than is normal in Norway. Permanent residence becomes available after three years. Applicants from mainland China should note that UDI explicitly names China among the countries whose vocational qualification documents are frequently found to be fraudulent, so vocational-level cases are scrutinised much more closely.

This does not affect eligibility, but it does affect the real approval rate for vocational-level applications.

给需要到澳大利亚参加职业培训、或去做与专业相关的结构化工作培训的人用的临时签证，: A temporary visa for people who need to come to Australia for occupational training, or for structured workplace training related to their occupation, lasting up to 2 years. The order is fixed: sponsor first, nomination second. An Australian employer (or a Commonwealth government agency) must first be approved as a sponsor and must separately lodge a nomination for your training program that Home Affairs approves, and only then can you apply for the visa. During training you may do work directly related to it, but this is not a way to take an ordinary job. From 2026-11-12 you must be outside Australia both when you apply and when the visa is granted.
官方资格清单按「担保 + 提名 + 个人条件」判定，未按国籍设限；中国大陆护照持: The official eligibility list tests three things — sponsor, nomination and personal circumstances — and sets no limit by nationality, so mainland Chinese passport holders can apply. Eligibility runs in two stages: the first gate is salary — the monthly salary must meet the EP threshold for your age band (from S$5,600 at age 23 and under to S$10,700 at age 45 and over), and the second gate is the COMPASS points assessment. You must clear both to qualify. From 2027-01-01 the thresholds rise by one band (from S$6,000 at age 23 and under to S$11,500 at age 45 and over), so anyone negotiating salary now must look at the new table.

The real constraints are whether a Singapore employer is willing to hire you at a qualifying salary, and the COMPASS score — both of which are tied to the employer.
官方不设年龄上下限，但年龄直接决定薪资门槛：23 岁及以下最低 S$5,600，: The official rules set no minimum or maximum age, but age directly determines the salary threshold: S$5,600 at age 23 and under, rising by a fixed band for each additional year, up to S$10,700 at age 45 and over. This field is recorded as bachelor_completed, a conservative reading: in practice a degree holder is more likely to meet the salary and scoring requirements, but the official rules do not state that a bachelor degree is a single hard requirement. Run the numbers in the MOM Self-Assessment Tool before submitting.

官方资格条件未设年龄限制。0–99 表示「无年龄门槛」，不是「未核实」。: The official eligibility conditions set no age limit. A range of 0–99 means "no age threshold", not "to be verified".

Note the difference from France: France requires the master level, while Spain accepts a bachelor degree.

官方要求证明经济能力（medios económicos）。具体金额按当期 IP: The official conditions require evidence of economic means (medios económicos). 须提供医疗保险（seguro médico）与无犯罪记录证明（certifica: You must provide medical insurance (seguro médico) and a criminal record certificate (certificado de antecedentes penales).

2026-10-30 未重抓。年龄 18-28 与项目费属于中国落地口径，不是美: Not re-fetched on 2026-10-30. The 18-28 age band and the programme fee reflect how Chinese universities operate the scheme, not a U.S. Department of State rule.
